pages.title: Hanami Tale
pages.text: Pink Petals · Flower Drink$(br2)Brewed from the Pink Petals Tea Bag in a teapot with milk; yields twelve cups.$(br2)$(br2)Falling cherry blossoms, blossoms yet to fall - all shall fall.$(br2)— Ryōkan, death poem

pages.text: Orbiting petals block incoming projectiles.$(br2)$(br2)Petal Veil 3:00
